event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov (time UNVERIFIED, likely 15:30 SAST). No high-impact US release today (Forexuro).

bullets.title: Bounce fading
bullets.text: Gold was 4,037.90 at 15:31 SAST, up only 6.10 (+0.15%), after a range of 4,025.80 to 4,067.90 today (Kitco).

bullets.title: Capped at 4,068
bullets.text: The morning high of 4,067.90 has held all day and price has given back about 30 dollars of the bounce.

bullets.title: Dollar firmer
bullets.text: The dollar index is up 0.43% near 102.67 and the US 10-year yield is near 4.99%, which weighs on gold (Trading Economics, 5paisa).

bullets.title: Hot CPI backdrop
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected and core rose 0.3% against 0.2%, which dragged gold down about 2.6% on Tuesday (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Hike bets high
bullets.text: Trading Economics puts December hike odds near 91%, up from 84%, and Mitrade says a December hike is fully priced (the sources differ).

bullets.title: Fed speakers hawkish
bullets.text: Waller and Logan back further tightening, which keeps pressure on gold rallies (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Quiet calendar
bullets.text: No high-impact US release is due today, so the next big test is Friday's PPI (Forexuro, Goodreturns).
